archetypes.name: kv-contract
archetypes.rationale: The KV handoff between compute-pr-line-counts.sh and write-final-report.sh is a new inter-script interface; mismatched variable names or parse patterns are the highest-likelihood plan defect.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that every KV key printed by compute-pr-line-counts.sh (LINES_STATUS, CODE_ADDED, CODE_DELETED, LOGS_ADDED, LOGS_DELETED) is parsed by exactly the same name in write-final-report.sh, with no typo divergence. Check whether the plan's set +e capture and local-variable parse pattern correctly handles the skipped and unavailable status values distinctly, and that the empty-default fallback for each key is applied before the values are forwarded to render-run-summary.sh. Confirm the plan does not conflate the two non-ok statuses in the N/A display path (both produce the same bullet text but arrive via different helper exit shapes). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: render-placement
archetypes.rationale: The plan specifies an insertion anchor ('immediately after - **Code review**:') and a skill-guard variable name ('SKILL') in render-run-summary.sh without verifying these literals exist; a mismatch silently omits the bullet or breaks the guard.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read render-run-summary.sh and confirm that the literal string '- **Code review**:' exists as the anchor for the new bullet, and that the variable used for skill-gating is actually named SKILL (not SKILL_NAME or a similar variant). Check that compose_self_fallback in write-final-report.sh exists and that the plan's bullet order there matches the main render path so schema parity holds. Confirm the four new flags (--code-added, --code-deleted, --logs-added, --logs-deleted) do not collide with any existing argument names already parsed in render-run-summary.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: makefile-wiring
archetypes.rationale: The plan says to register test-compute-pr-line-counts in a 'test-harnesses-N shard' mirroring test-compose-pr-summary without specifying the shard number; picking the wrong shard silently drops the test from CI.
archetypes.prompt_body: Read the Makefile and find which test-harnesses-N shard currently contains test-compose-pr-summary (or its nearest analogue), then verify the plan's claim that mirroring it for test-compute-pr-line-counts is correct. Check that the harness-timer.sh invocation pattern and the .PHONY declaration for the new target match every existing test-* target in that shard exactly. Flag if the plan leaves the shard assignment underspecified, since an arbitrary assignment could exclude the new test from a parallel CI shard. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
